newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: BPI drops more than 3 pct after results.
newsitem.headline: BPI drops more than 3 pct after results.

text.p: Shares of Banco Portugues de Investimento fell more than three percent on Lisbon bourse as the bank's 1996 results did not meet the highly optimistic expectations of the market, dealers said.
"In the past two weeks the market was very optimistic about the results of BPI. Some people expected a profit of more than 16 billion escudos, and so we have seen a correction today," a dealer said.
Another said: "The optimism was extended to the dividend. Some people expected to see 100 escudos per share for 1996."
BPI, Portugal's fourth biggest private bank, reported a 56 percent increase in 1996 profits to 15.1 billion escudos ($90 million) on Wednesday.
The board decided to propose a gross dividend of 85 escudos per share, which represents a five percent increase over the 100 escudos paid in 1995, adjusted for a capital increase at the end of 1995.
BPI shares stood at 2,491 escudos, down 88, in volume of 41,918 shares at 1107 GMT.
